title: Eval incentive acceptance criteria & usage tracking
text:
Eval incentive acceptance criteria & usage tracking

["From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@medscale.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Question on incentives for RFP bakeoff

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We're preparing the internal RFP for our physician- facing assistant pilot and want to make sure incentives are aligned. The procurement team asked whether Redwood can provide a modest credit pool for a controlled head-to-head bakeoff against two incumbent vendors (3-week evaluation, up to 25k tokens/day simulated traffic).

What we need to confirm from your side:
- A clear statement of how credits will be provisioned/expired (we prefer a time-boxed trial window).
- Any acceptance criteria you require for the bakeoff (quality thresholds, sample tests).
- Whether usage tracking can be provided daily so our ops and ML teams can reconcile usage with outcome metrics.

Appreciate a quick note — procurement wants the draft terms by EOD Friday.

Thanks,
Elena Ortiz
Director, Product Operations
MedScale Health

---
Attachment: rfp-schedule.xlsx (attachment stub)", "From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@medscale.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Question on incentives for RFP bakeoff

Hi Elena — great to meet you yesterday.

Short answer: yes, we can support a time-boxed credit pool plus daily usage reporting with a couple of conditions so we keep things fair for everyone. Below is a proposed quick termset you can slot into your RFP:

Proposed Redwood bakeoff credit terms (summary)
- Credit allocation: $7,500 in platform credits applied to account RDW-4892, valid for 30 days from provisioning.
- Scope: credits cover hosted inference (text generation + embeddings) usage only; any Dedicated/Private work or premium integrations billed separately.
- Acceptance criteria: deliver a reproducible benchmark harness (our suggested template attached) and agree on 3 sample prompt suites (shared prior to the test). If both sides run the same suites and results are consistent, we accept the comparison.
- Usage tracking: daily CSV export (example attached) delivered to your ops mailbox and a shared Drive link. We can also provide token-level breakdown by route.
- Excess usage: any consumption above the credit pool will be billed at our standard trial overage rate; you can optionally request a one-time top-up if needed.

I've attached a short term sheet and the usage tracking template — Marissa/Ben, flag anything that needs finance/legal signoff.

If that looks OK, Elena, I can provision the credits and push the tracking exports to ops@medscale.com.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-eval-credit-term-sheet.pdf, usage-tracking-template.csv", "From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 14:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Question on incentives for RFP bakeoff

Sean — thanks for drafting. A few ops/finance notes before we commit: 

1) Credit amount and duration: $7.5k for 30 days is inline with typical bakeoff support; please confirm token estimate and expected throughput profile (peak TPS) so infra can ensure capacity.
2) Accounting tag: please apply promo code RDW-EVAL-4892 so we can reconcile in billing.
3) Reporting: daily CSV to ops@medscale.com plus a Drive link is fine; add a single-line summary email each morning with cumulative consumption and remaining credit.
4) Legal: I asked Legal whether we need a short side letter; they recommended a 1-paragraph statement saying credits are promotional and not a cash refund. I'll attach their recommended phrasing.

Ben — could you confirm that the proposed overage rate is the standard trial overage? We should also note any constraints around model families (e.g., quantized smaller variants allowed for fair comparison) — if we restrict to hosted models only, mention it.

Once we have Ben/Legal signoff, Sean, go ahead and provision and loop Elena. Keep Neha in the loop for deal uplift tracking.

Marissa Cole
Head of Growth Programs, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

> On Thu, Jul 19, 2028 at 11:03 AM Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > Hi Elena — great to meet you yesterday....

Attachments: legal-sideletter-suggested.txt", "From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@medscale.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@medscale.com
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Question on incentives for RFP bakeoff

Thanks, Sean and Marissa — this is very helpful.

We accept the proposed $7,500 credit, 30-day window, and the reporting cadence. Procurement reviewed the legal paragraph and is OK with the promotional credit language. A couple of quick follow-ups:
- Can you provision credits to the sandbox account we shared (medscale-sandbox@redwood.ai)?
- Please send the first daily report on Monday morning PST — we'll run a warmup on Friday but the official 3-week window starts Monday.
- For acceptance criteria, our ML lead asked whether Redwood can whitelist the evaluation suite on your side to prevent caching artifacts — happy to share the suite once signoff is complete.

If you can confirm provisioning and the Drive link, we'll insert the term summary into the RFP doc.

Best,
Elena Ortiz
Director, Product Operations
MedScale Health

---
Forwarded: Sean's term sheet attached.

Attachments: rfp-draft-v1.docx (attachment stub)"]
